propositions: The workflow editor must expose a separate read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot, showing criterion gate, tier, posture, applicability, and provenance without allowing serialization of edits back to YAML/BPMN.

Creating or saving a project code-review LLM criterion requires a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative applies_to globs; missing or empty selectors are rejected with remedy suggestion use ["**"] for repository-wide.
Authored Workflow must remain the sole editable topology, with authored documents round-tripping byte-equivalently regardless of effective policy changes.
Snapshot load or validation failures must mark Effective Policy unavailable with actionable error and prevent save; packaged defaults must never be silently substituted.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review applies_at/trigger authoring are exempt from the project-LLM glob validation rule.
Editor payloads must exclude per-unit discovery trace, prompt/context body, provider response, and secrets.
